s01b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s01b02.text: So, I was having a memory, of the first story I wrote about my emotions.

s01b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s01b03.text: And the more I read, the more I was back inside my mind.

s02b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s02b02.text: And my fear kept pulling the fire alarm.

s02b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s02b03.text: So I imagined myself as the CEO of my mind, looking around to see why.

s02b04.speaker: CONSCIOUSNESS
s02b04.text: Fear? What are you looking at?

s03b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s03b03.text: Huge. Unmoving. And its face was pure darkness.

s04b03.speaker: FEAR
s04b03.text: That's what scares me. It's not safe here.

s04b04.speaker: CONSCIOUSNESS
s04b04.text: Nothing is going to hurt you.

s05b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s05b03.text: Panic attacks, forcing every emotion out of my mind.

s06b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s06b01.text: Then one day, I put my hand on my fear's shoulder.

s06b03.speaker: CONSCIOUSNESS
s06b03.text: You need to stop pulling the fire alarm.

s06b05.speaker: FEAR
s06b05.text: I'm only trying to keep us safe.

s07b03.speaker: CONSCIOUSNESS
s07b03.text: we need to put you in a time-out.

s08b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s08b01.text: So I put my fear into a cage.

s08b02.speaker: FEAR
s08b02.text: Please don't leave me with it.

s09b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s09b01.text: I told myself it was the responsible thing to do.

s10b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s10b01.text: And the Void stood there, stone-faced, its shadow filling half the room.

s11b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s11b01.text: And then, when I wasn't looking, I had an image in my mind.

s12b08.speaker: FEAR
s12b08.text: Why are you just standing there?

s12b09.speaker: FEAR
s12b09.text: Are you just here to scare me forever?

s12b11.speaker: NARRATOR
s12b11.text: And the Void did not move. It stood there.

s13b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s13b03.text: My fear thought the Void had had enough of its complaining, and would destroy it.

s13b04.speaker: NARRATOR
s13b04.text: But then, my fear felt a hand on its shoulder.

s13b06.speaker: NARRATOR
s13b06.text: And it looked up, into the face of the Void.

s14b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s14b02.text: And instead of darkness, my fear saw the twinkling of lights.

s14b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s14b03.text: Like galaxies, and nebulae, and stars of the universe.

s14b04.speaker: NARRATOR
s14b04.text: The Void, filled with bits and pieces of meaning.

s14b06.speaker: NARRATOR
s14b06.text: And for once, my fear wasn't afraid. It felt wonder, and amazement.

s14b08.speaker: FEAR
s14b08.text: Why are you showing me this?

s14b10.speaker: NARRATOR
s14b10.text: And the Void stared into the screen of my consciousness.

s15b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s15b01.text: My other emotions were looking back.

s15b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s15b03.text: They smiled, just for a moment, then went back to helping me.

s16b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s16b02.text: Then my fear felt the gentle push of the Void.

s16b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s16b03.text: The Void stood there, with galaxies twinkling in its dark facade.

s18b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s18b02.text: The old cage had rusted, its gate hanging open.

s18b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s18b03.text: But that was just a small detail.

s19b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s19b01.text: Because the scene changed, to my emotions at the console.

s19b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s19b02.text: And the Void, standing in the background.

s19b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s19b03.text: I could barely see that rusty cage anymore, in the back of my mind.

s20b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s20b03.text: I may have shed a tear or two myself.
